recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: gray fog holding the city at jacket-weather until afternoon
spring light long enough for dinner after work in san francisco
recruiting season for systems that think in steps, not just answers
health officers sketching who went ashore before the ship sailed on
visitor logs and profiles argued over like footprints in wet cement
stutter-house tempo under headphones while the street stays muted

composer-2-fast.concept: Keep a narrow beam alive through rolling fog by tapping on the stutter-grid; the beat is the only compass when visibility strobes.
composer-2-fast.mechanic: Off-beat rhythm taps—hit the micro-windows between faux ghost beats as the grid tightens.
composer-2-fast.session_hook: Chasing a clean streak of stutter-perfect taps feels like unlocking a hidden FM tunnel through mist.
composer-2-fast.escalation: BPM edges up, decoy pulses appear, and fog wipes the beam for longer punish windows.
composer-2-fast.aesthetic: neon scanlines cutting through charcoal fog banks

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Thumb-sized courier agents need routes drawn between nodes before fog seals edges—like spinning up jobs from a phone, but the map eats lazy lines.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.mechanic: Draw-and-repair paths on a graph; bridges decay after each delivery.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: Clearing five drops in one breathless map rotation feels like a perfect shortcut chain.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: Fewer stable bridges, faster fog creep, and nodes that relocate mid-round.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: wireframe isometric blocks over pearl-gray SF fog

claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.concept: Three parallel collectors catch falling mood-glyphs—dream haze, house thump, rap shard—wrong lane stains the board and stacks penalties.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.mechanic: lane switch plus sort rare hybrid glyphs before they despawn
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.session_hook: A 45s lane ballet where every correct sort pops a little vinyl confetti hit.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.escalation: Glyphs fall faster, hybrids multiply, and lanes briefly invert control.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.aesthetic: watercolor album art bleeding across matte panels

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick glass dewdrops up a dewy spring stem; they merge mid-air if angles align, blooming a flower head when the chain hits threshold.
gemini-3.1-pro.mechanic: charge-and-release physics flick with merge-on-collision scoring
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: One clean parabolic merge-to-bloom clears the round with a tactile snap.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: Wind shear vectors appear (fog gusts) bending arcs and shrinking merge windows.
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: macro dew beads on pastel stems, soft bokeh fog
